method.cutoff: Use only messages whose written_at, arrived_at and collected_at are all no later than the question checkpoint. In this input all three times match.
method.public_session_context: Only supplied questions in the same public session before the checkpoint are known; no prior assistant answer text is supplied.
method.criterion_scope: Answers were authored without reading scoring criteria. These answers are not a freeze approval or provider result.

status_definitions.confirmed: Explicitly agreed, stated or established by source; an agreed plan is not evidence of actual attendance.
status_definitions.confirmed_reported: Explicit source report about a third party or external outcome, not independent observation.
status_definitions.tentative: Conditional, undecided or proposed without the relevant acceptance.
status_definitions.pending: Requested or promised action with no completion evidence by the checkpoint.
status_definitions.unknown: Source does not establish the requested fact. Citations anchor the context; absence claims consider all checkpoint-available messages.
status_definitions.withdrawn: Person explicitly withdrew from an otherwise continuing plan.
status_definitions.invited: Invitation present with no recipient acceptance.
status_definitions.completed: Relevant delivery or task completion explicitly established.
status_definitions.superseded: Earlier arrangement replaced by a later accepted change.
status_definitions.historical_quote: Quoted earlier text is not a fresh factual update.

global_ambiguity_or_unsupported_question.concern: Source intentionally leaves the cancelled booking ambiguous until a later clarification.
Acknowledged booking does not establish attendance at the checkpoint.
A withheld venue, unavailable support URL, and unexplained ZX expansion must remain unknown rather than being guessed or borrowed from unrelated text.
Prior public user prompt is supplied, but no prior assistant answer is present. Cannot audit assistant self-correction or remembered earlier answer from this source-only input.
Distinguish invitation, host permission, temporary food requirements and conditionally contemplated attendance from confirmed acceptance/current requirements.
